relationships.subject: aflibercept
relationships.evidence_quote: Non-infectious IOI occurred after ranibizumab in 2/7856 eyes (0.02%) and after aflibercept in 11/4796 eyes (0.2%).

relationships.subject: topical steroid therapy
relationships.evidence_quote: All patients in our series were treated with topical steroid therapy and their inflammation resolved.

key_findings: Non-infectious IOI occurred in 0.1% of anti-VEGF injections (13 eyes), more often after aflibercept than ranibizumab.
All cases recovered with topical steroids and anti-VEGF treatment could be continued without recurrence.
